brief:
Gaza's health ministry documented 17 deaths across the territory over the preceding 48 hours, according to Shehab Wire. The casualties comprised five people killed in recent strikes, one individual who succumbed to wounds sustained earlier, and 11 bodies recovered from prior operations. The same period saw 27 people injured.

The figures emerged from the ministry's daily casualty report submitted to hospitals across Gaza. Health officials have maintained regular statistical accounting of deaths and injuries as fighting continues in the enclave. The breakdown distinguishes between newly killed, those dying from existing injuries, and recovered remains, reflecting the ongoing toll of the conflict on civilian and combatant populations.
